$comment: The gi-probe build ingest runs (A§5.2 step 5; merged R28, R30): astra-game-launcher 0.7.0's static-pie musl Linux x86_64 binary (tag v0.7.0 on 417e57d; spec pin c7ae74a, unchanged from 0.5.1), built from `git archive v0.7.0`. bin/fetch-gi-probe.mjs refuses a download whose digest differs. Link-v1 stage 2: `check` now also judges `[integration.link].knowledge` (link-v1.md §5 Knowledge: a folder of the zip, at most 256 .md files of UTF-8 text, each at most 256 KiB, together at most 4 MiB, at most 4 folders deep, no link) as link-invalid{field=integration.link.knowledge, reason=not-a-folder|not-in-zip|link|too-deep|not-markdown|too-large|not-utf8|too-many}; 0.5.1 refused every manifest carrying integration.link.knowledge* keys as unknown (astra-valheim v0.2.9: 37 findings, now 0). The CLI and the report's keys are unchanged from 0.5.1 (which implements games content round 3, mods-invalid, TOML 1.0 and link.digest).
